a: बिभीषण — a. 1 Terrifying, frightening, intimidating. --2 Formidable, terrible. --3 Bullying or blustering (as language). --णं, --णा 1 Terrifying. --2 A means of terrifying, terror. --णः N. of a demon and brother of Rāvaṇa. [Though a demon by birth, he was extremely sorry for the abduction of Sītā by Rāvaṇa, and severely reprimanded him for his wicked act. He several times advised Rāvaṇa to restore Sītā to Rāma if he cared to live; but the proud demon turned a deaf ear to his warnings. At last seeing that the ruin of his brother was inevitable, he repaired to Rāma and became his staunch friend. After the death of Rāvaṇa, Rāma installed him on the throne of Laṅkā. He is believed to be one of the seven Cirajīvins; see चिरजीविन्.]

बिंदुः — [बिंद् --उ] 1 A drop, small particle; जलबिंदुनिपातेन क्रमशः पूर्यते घटः ‘small drops make a pool’; विस्तीर्यते यशो लोके तैलबिंदुरिवांभसि Ms. 7. 33; संक्षिप्यते येशो लोके घृतबिंदुरिवांभसि 7. 34; अधुता ( कुतूहलस्य) बिंदुरपि नावशेषितः Ś. 2. --2 A dot, point. --3 A spot or mark of coloured paint on the body of an elephant; Ku. 1. 7. --4 A zero or cypher; न रोमकूपौघामेषाज्जगत्कृता कृताश्च किं दूषणशून्यबिंदवः N. 1. 21. --5 (In geom.) A point having no parts or no magnitude. --6 A drop of water taken as a measure. --7 The dot over a letter representing the अनुस्वार. --8 (In manuscripts) A mark over an erased word (which shows that the word ought not to be erased). --9 A mark made by the teeth of a lover on the lips of his mistress. --10 A peculiar mark like a dot made in cauterizing. --11 The part of the forehead between the eyebrows. --12 (In dramas) The sudden development of a secondary incident (which, like a drop of oil in water, quickly diffuses itself and thus supplies important elements in the development of the plot; it is the source of an intermediate object, while the ‘Bīja’ is that of the principal one); अवांतरार्थ विच्छंदे बिंदुरुच्छेदकारणं S. D. 319. --Comp. --चित्रकः the spotted antelope. --जालं, --जालकं {1} a number of drops. {2} marks of colouredpaint on the trunk and face of an elephant. --तंत्रः {1} a die. {2} a chess-board. --देवः an epithet of Śiva. --पत्रः a kind of birch tree. --फलं a pearl. --रेखकः {1} an anusvāra. {2} a kind of bird. --रेखा a line of dots. --वासरः the day of conception.

v: pu॰ bila--ulbA॰ ni॰ । 1 svanAmaKyAte vfkze amaraH “SrIPalaH pravarastikto grAhI rUkzo'gnipittakft । bAlaH Slezmaharo balyo laGuruzRaSca pAcanaH” BAvapra॰ । “bilvaM bAlaM kazAyozRaM pAcanaM vahnidIpanam । saMgrAhi tiktakawukaM tIkzRaM vAtakaPAPam । pakvaM suganDi maDuraM durjaraM grAhi dozalam । Palezu paripakvezu yo guRaH samudAhftaH । bilvAdanyatra sajYeyo bilvamAnaM guRottaram । kaPavAtAmapittaGnI grAhiRI bilvapezikA” rAjavallaBaH । “kAYjike saMsTitaM bilvamagnisandIpanaM param” iti vEdyakam । 2 tatPale na॰ medi॰ । 3 palaparimARe na॰ SabdamAlA । tadvfkzotpattyAdiryaTA “BfgorlakzmISca yA DenurgorupA sA gatA mahIm । tadgomayaBavo bilvaH SrISca tasmAdajAyata । “bilvavfkzaH priyaH SamBostava yonirBavizyati । sarvapuzpottamaH SrezWo devAhAro manoramaH । acCedyaH parvvasvetezusarvvalokAnAM CedAnnASaH sadA nfRAm । ye ca pApA durAcArAH SrItaroSCedakAriRaH । te tvavIcyAdinarake pAtyante brahmaRodinam । suduHKitA Bavizyanti narA duzkulinaH sadA । tatra deSe BayaM nityaM ciraM rAjA na jIvati । na ca dravyapatiH kaScid bilvavfkzasya CedakaH । kriyate yatra vicCedaH sapuzpaPalinastaroH । anAvfzwiBayaM GoraM tasmin deSe prajAyate” । agnipu॰ । vfhadDarmapurARe 10 a॰ asyotpattiranyayoktA “lakzmyA SivArADanArTaM svEkastanasyotpAwane kfte tuzwena Sivena lakzmIM pratyuktaM yaTA “mAtaH samudratanaye! mA mA CinDistanaM param । yaste CinnaH stano vAmo jAyatAM punareva saH । jYAtA te paramA BaktiH pUrRastena manoraTaH । yaSca CinnaH stanoBaktyA malliNkopari te SuBe । so'stu vfkzaH kzitO puRyo nAmnA cIPala ityataH । mUrttimAMstava vE BaktirvfkzaH SrIPalanAmakaH । tvatkIrttaye kzitAvAstAM yAvaccandradivAkarO । sa tarurmamavE lakzmi! paramaH supriyo Bavet । natpatreREva me pUjA Bavizyati na cAnyaTA । svarRamuktAprabAlAdi puzpARyanyAni ca Druvam । SrIPalacCadaleSasya kalAM nArhanti kowikAm । yaTA me SrIPalataruryaTA juNgAjalaM mama । taTA priyatamaM lakzmi! tripadmaH SroPalaYjadaH” tatrEva 11 a॰ । “DanuH SataYcAsya sUtAt KaYcAgraM tIrTasucyate । aDo BUmestaTA tIrTamatastIrTatrayaM saKi! । UrdDapatraM haro jYeyaH patraM vAma viDiH svayam । ahaM dakziRapatraYca tripatradalamityuta । asya CAyAYca patraYca laNGayenna padA spfSet । harate laNGanAdAyuH padA sparSAt SriyaM haret” । ityAdinA tanmAhAtmyamuktvA tatpatraharaRaviDAnAdi tatroktaM yaTA “pakzAntadvAdaSIsAyamaDyAhnaBinnakAlataH । SAKABaNgo na karttavyo nEvArohettaTA tarum । varamAruhya cinuyAnna SAKABaYjanaM kvacit । KaRqitESca SivaH pUjyaH patrEranyESca KaRqitEH । zaRmAsAnantaraM bilvapatraM paryyu zite Bavet । pUjyA etena vE devAH sUryyalambodarO vinA । bilvavfkzavanaM yatra sA tu bArARasI purI । paYca bilvadrumA yatra tatra tizWet svayaM hariH । sapta bilvadrumA yatra tatra durgAyuto haraH । eko bilvataruyatra tatra SamBu maryA saha । bilvavfkzA yatra daSa tatra SamBurgaREH saha । etAnyuktAni tIrTAni devAH sarve marudgaRO । yatra vAwyAM gfhasTasya koRa ISAnanAmake । jAyate SrIPalatarurna tatra vipadaH kvacit । pUrvasyAM suKadaH sa syAddakziRe yamaBItihA । paScime ca prajAdAyI vfkzo bilva udAhftaH । SmaSAne ca nadItIre prAntare vA vanAntare । bilvavfkzatalaM prokta sidDapIWasTalaM samem । na maDyaprANgaRe vfkzaM sTApayet SrIPalAKyakam । dEvAd yadi prajAyeta tadA Sivavadarccayet । cEtrAdicaturo mAsAn SamBave paramAtmane । dattaM syAd bilvapatrEkaM lakzaDenusarma surAH । maDyAhnakAle ye martyA bilvaM kuryyuH pradakziRam । tEH sumerurgirivaraH kftaeva pradakziRam । na cCindyAt SrIPalataruM na dahet kAzWameva ca । vinA brAhmaRayajYArTaM patito bilvavikrayI । pakvabilvasamudGfzwaM yo Datte mUrDni mAnavaH । yamADikAro nAtra syAt hftaH pApopapAtakEH । vilvapatraM PalaM vIjaM BUmO patitamISvaraH । svayaM gfhRAti SirasA vEyarTyaBayaSaNkitaH । cEtrAdicaturo mAsAn siYcedbilvataruM kftI । yaTA snigDo BavedvfkzastaTA tatpitaro'pi ca । cEtrAdivaturo mAsAn sadA Bramati SaNkaraH । navInabilvapatrArTI BuktimuktipradAyakaH । hadidrAnagare yatra vEdyanATo maheSvaraH । tatrAkzayo bilvavfkzaH svargavfkza udAhftaH । kAmarUpe kAmataruH kASyA muktastaTAdimaH । kAYcIpure puraH proktaH SrIPalo'kzayapuRyadaH । te'pi tIrTaviSezAH syuratIrTezvapi sadA'tulAH .” vfkza rmapu॰ 11 a॰ । “tatPalEstatprasUnErvA tatpatrEryaH prapUjayet । tatkAzWacandanErvApi sa me BaktaH sa me priyaH । tatkAzWacandanaM BAle yo DArayati samBramAt । tattanuM SivabudDyA sA nameddevI mudAnvitA । atastaccandanaM devi! na DArayati kaScana । tatpatraM tat prasUnaM vA kadApi DArayenna hi । tasyamUle maheSAni! prARAMstyajati yo naraH । rudradeho Bavet satyaM pApa kowiyuto'pi san” yoginItantre pawale । “bilvavfkzaM taTA devi! BagavAn SaNkaraH svayam । bilvavfkzatale sTitvA yadi prARAMstyajet suDIH । tatkzaRAsmokzamApnoti kintasya tIrTakowiBiH । yatra brahmAdayo devAstizWanti muktihetave । bilvavfkzatale sTAnaM yadi vizWAdipUritam । tadeva SANkaraM kzetraM sarvatIrTamayaM sadA । sarvapIWamayaM tattu sarvadevamayaM sadA । na tyajet SANkaraM kzetraM na ca gaNgAM tyajet priye! । samIpe sa ca cArbaNgi । bilbavfkzO yadi priye! । kASIpurasamaM tattu tatra prARAn tyajed yadi । kintasya kowitIrTena kASIvAsena kiM priye! । puraScaraRarasollAse 10 pawale । taddAnaviDiryaTA “patraM vA yadi vA puzpaM PalaM nezwamaDomuKam । yaTotpannaM taTA deyaM bilbapatrARyaDomuKam .” mAtfkAtantre 55 pawale । “Siva uvAca । SfRu devi! pravakzyAmi raharsya trijawAtmakam । patraM brahmamayaM devi! adButa vara varRini! । SrISElaSiKare jAtaH SrIPalaH SrIniketanaH । vizRuprItikaraScEva mama prItikaraH sadA । brahmavizRuSivAH patre vfntaYca SaktirUpakam । vfntamUle tu vajraM syAt patre brahmapadaM priye! । trijawApatrakEkena haraM vA harimarccayet । kEvalyaM tasya temEva SaktipUjA viSezataH । patraM puzpaM PalaM toyaM nEvedyaM DUpadIpakam । dattvA yadyat PalaM prAptaM tasmAt kowiguRaM Bavet । sarvErarcanato devi! trijawAtmasattarpaRam । kEvalyado hariScEva dAsye'haM tvatsvarUpatAm । tvayi kEvalyadaM jYAnaM DarmakAmArTadaM priye! । vajrahInamidaM devi! prApnuyAdvAYCitaM Palam । savajre mriyate nyUnaM vajrAGAtena pArvati! । tasmAcca sADakendreRa vajrahInaM pradIyate” । DARaM gfhItvA yo gacCet sarvasidDimavApnuyAt । UrdDvaM sudarSanaM rakzedaDaH paSupatistaTA । puro mAheSvarI rakzet pfzWe ca SUlaDAriRI । dakzapArSve ca SrInATo vAmapArSve prajApatiH । candra sUryyO DftO CatramahaMvAdakarO sadA” । jYAnaBEravatantre 6 pawale । bilvaSabdasya bargyabopaDatve'pi mudrAkzare tAdfSavarRRA BAvAt antyasTabopaDatvaM pUjitaM sarvatra tasyASudDatvaM boDyam ।
